nom: COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream For Face & Body

avis.texte: The best lotion super creamy and moisturizing but light enough to dry fast and jeep your skin smooth and hydrated

I really like this moisturizer but i don't like the container. The moisturizer is more of a lotion and not thick enough to be in a tub. I accidentally tipped the container and spilled a lot. Other than the packaging, its a great moisturizer for sensitive skin.

Wow this may become my new staple body moisturizer for post shower. It's so light and almost gel like but deeply moisturizes. My skin feels supple and moisturized for at least the whole day if not beyond. Zero fragrance, doesn't pill. 10/10!
For the amount of product you're receiving for the price is not bad , good on the body but left my face dry even after serums still left my skin so dry
This is just the best moisturizing cream my 15-year-old daughter has ever used.
This is perfect! This cream doesn't feel too light or too thick for my skin, I use it on my face, neck, chest, hands, and arms I love it!
I loved this moisturizer. My skin can get very dry and can sometimes be sensitive to certain products. This was non greasy and did not irritate my skin. Moisturized well.
I have tried many moisturizer and this one has been the best one yet. You feel refreshed after applying the product and wake up with glowing skin the following morning. 10/10

I love the cos rx barrier moisturizer cream. It is very effective at repairing the skin and keeping it moisturized and healthy. I use alot of high end creams and this is definitely one of my favorite no fuss products with no irritants; perfect for when your skin needs a break from everything but the basics. It is very nice, and doesn't leave your skin greasy or break you out.
This has become my favorite body lotion. It really leaves my skin soft and hydrated.

I had tried everything short of removing my skin to get rid of stubborn, scaly patches on my legs and nothing worked. It was so embarrassing!! After using this for just one week, scales that had been there for decades and survived countless useless products were completely gone. This is the first product that actually delivered real, visible results, and I'm honestly blown away
I love it! It goes on light and smooth and makes my skin feels soft and hydrated!
I really like this moisturizing cream. It leaves my skin soft and hydrated. It's not greasy after application. I'm glad Cosrx created this product.

this cream is awesome for dry skin, not nutritive but humectant. Because I had problems with another spray product of this same brand that came faulty and they gave me a very hard time to replace it, I don't think I will buy from this brand again. I may stay with a broken spray but they lost a customer.

This is an amazingly rich product. I have super dry skin, but this formula has kept my skin moisturized for over 24 hours. The cream goes on easily and spreads out nicely. Its something that I plan to keep in my routine.
This is the best moisturizer I have ever tried! My face feels amazing with this on my skin. It keeps my face hydrated all day without the sticky feeling!
Great moisturizer doesn't leave a greasy film and sinks into skin beautifully.
It hydrates my skin especially this fall/winter season when I tend to have eczema due to weather changes.
This has done absolute wonders for my skin in just a few days. I have chronically dry upper arms and elbows, especially in the colder months, and this has saved me like nothing else!

The size is incredible and the cream is quite nice, especially on elbows. That said I was hoping it would be a richer cream to replace my holikaholika ceramide cream for winter chapped skin and this doesnt seem to have the oomph for that task.
I love that it's very hydrating! And it's also big, should last me for a while !
Very thick cream but I love it. It really leaves my skin soft and gets rid of my dryness.
I use other cosrx products and have just added this moisturizing cream. It is easy to apply, absorbs into skin and my skin feels very soft after using.
Great value for the large amount of product, extremely hydrating and doesn't have any strong perfumes.

Oh my gosh I love this stuff. It feels so calming on my skin. I use a nice amount right at the end of my skin routine and I love that it's good for the body cuz I slather all over my face, neck, and chest. The consistency feels so creamy and my skin feels so hydrated and smooth.

I'm honestly so impressed with this cream! From the very first use, my skin felt deeply nourished, soft, and calm. It has that perfect balance—rich enough to really support my skin barrier, but not heavy or greasy. I love how quickly it absorbs and leaves my skin feeling plump, hydrated, and smooth all day. If you struggle with sensitivity, dryness, or just want to keep your skin barrier healthy, this is such a reliable go-to. It's one of those products where you can feel the difference right away—my skin just felt comforted and stronger. Definitely a new staple in my routine! 🌿💧
I love this cream, it feels so luxurious on my dry skin and I use it every time after showering. I would definitely purchase this again and again.

It penetrates quickly with no afterfeel, so it's very comfortable to wear. It has plenty of hydration for my face, but in the winter I'll need something richer for my body. I'd enjoy it more with a light fragrance.
Oh wahoo, this is the first time I am getting a cream that suits my skin, Norish perfectly. The effect is noticeable after few use.

So far I really like it as a body cream! :) It isn't too thick and feels good to put on dry skin. Doesn't leave me feeling greasy. Haven't tried it on my face, but it's probably too thick for that unless it's the depths of winter lol.
This moisturizer is great. If you are looking for something highly moisturizing, this one is it. Personally, I think this moisturizer is best suited a night cream, rather than a day cream.

I love this Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream and know it's going to be a lifesaver in the colder months! The texture is super creamy and makes my skin feel soft and hydrated without leaving it greasy or sticky. A little product goes a long way with the amount on my fingers in the picture being able to cover my hands, arms, shoulders and chest. There is no fragrance so it is the perfect product to use in situations where it is advised, or even prohibited, to wear a product with any smell. This product is going to be a staple for my skin!

This has quickly become a staple in my morning and evening skin care routine. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving it feeling soft and hydrated. I'm impressed with how long the hydration lasts; my skin stays moisturized all day long. A little bit of the product goes a long way, which is a great bonus considering how generous the tub size is.

I have reviewed this 8/5/25 and give a 3 star. I have been using this ceramide jar for 22 days now. My right elbow( had scars from dermatitis -8 years ago using harsh prescription cream and from scratching) feels so soft and moist. I did not encounter skin allergy. I am very careful with skin products due to sensitive skin. I am happy with the product and will give this moisturizer 5 stars.

This ceramide cream has become my new holy grail! I have dry skin and usually the air conditioning makes it even worse, but this cream leaves my skin soft, smooth, and comfortable. plus the size is super biggg

avis.titre: My Holy Grail and new must have
avis.texte: This cream is my grail — the perfect barrier booster that smoothed out my bumps.

This cream has a nice consistency. It moisturizes the skin without leaving it sticky. It absorbs easily and feels very comfortable on the skin. The cream is nourishing without being heavy. I would definitely recommend this cream.

Cosrx never fails to bring new products that skin loves ❤️. I using for few weeks now and I can't stop using for my whole body. Healed my dry feet and hands. And made my hands so soft which is best for part for me. The hydration lasts long for days and very lightweight . Consistency is the key I will not say like over night results it takes time the only thing I feel is we need a scoop or small spatula which good to take the product out.

avis.titre: I love COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream
avis.texte: I love COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream. I have very dry arms with little dry bumps. I use this cream daily and in a few days the dry bumps were almost completely gone!! I love that it does not have a strong scent and the cream is thick but does not leave you feeling grease. Another winner from COSRX.
Love the skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream have used it a few days now and so far keeps the skin feeling hydrated

I've been using the COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream (450ml / 15. 21 fl. oz) for a week now, and I'm honestly shocked by the results! With its powerful booster combo of Ceramides + Panthenol (B5) + Hyaluronic Acid, it gives my body an incredible level of hydration. The best part is that it doesn't feel sticky at all — my skin absorbs it instantly, leaving it soft, smooth, and nourished. I'm super excited to continue using it and even repurchase, because I've always dreamed of finding a moisturizer that delivers deep hydration without any stickiness. This cream is truly a game-changer for body care lovers like me!

VERY lightweight moisturizing cream! I used a blueberry sized amount on my only hands, and after I worked it in, I could not tell anything was applied. In the morning, I could tell a difference with the moisture retention in my skin. My skin was hydrated and softer. I will continue to use on my body because I do not like greasy residue which this does not have.

I received the cream, it's really generous amount and have been using it twice daily, its good as a moisturizer but I expected more glow and softness to skin. It doesn't do that. The effects are more subtle and temporary

I have used this for about 4 days now since I received it and omG!!! Skin has never been this hydrated. My skin feels smooth and moisturized. I don't feel dry or ashy. There's no need to actually reapply lotion until my evening shower. I love the light creamy consistency it has. I will definitely be purchasing more of this cream. I wonder how it will feel in the winter but now this really works for me

The COSRX skin barrier moisturizing cream is amazing! It's extremely moisturizing without being heavy or greasy at all. My skin feels baby soft after just one application. I'm in love with this moisturizer!!!
This cream is so hydrating!! I use it everywhere, especially on my feet and feel like a new woman. Leaves my skin hydrated and soft. Order it! Promise you won't regret it
I have tried your new cream on my face and hands. I love it and know that it will help with my dry skin.

I love this product! I live in Las vegas so our skin here gets really dry at times. . because we are in the desert!! i hope cosrx will make this one but with atleast SPF 30 or up . . for complete protection

This stuff is amazing!! I put it all over my body post shower and it absorbs beautifully. I only use a quarter of the amount of product I would use in a regular lotion for body use. No breakouts, no greasy residue, and soft supple skin feel. My whole family has now been converted to the cosrx line! A++++

i'm really impressed with the cream. it's rich enough to keep my face moisturized but not so heavy that it clog up the skin. and i like the texture that i can do light massage on my face and even leave a thick layer as a cream mask. i just recently found out that this cream can also be used as body moisturizer. what a value in the jar!

This cream says it all. It glides easily and absorbs quickly. There is no odor which I like. I have sensitive skin but this cream doesn't irritate me. My skin feels so soft and smooth after applying. It doesn't feel sticky or creamy. I highly recommend this cream. I will not feel hesitate to order soon.
This cream is so smooth and feels so good on my skin. My skin feels soft to the touch and the moisture lasts a long time!

I was provided this product for free from Cosrx. I've only had it a few days but am shocked at how amazing it is. It's lightweight but still moisturizing. I used it immediately after getting out of the shower and did not have the usually tightness I experience. My skin feels well lubricated and soft. I will definitely buy this product again.

Absolutely loving this cream! I use it on my face mostly, but I also use it on super dry areas of my body. I work in healthcare and so my hands get dry very fast, so I will slather this cream onto my hands before bed and then I wake up with silky hands ✨ 🤚 I also like the way it makes my face feel, it doesn't make my skin too oily, but also doesn't leave it feeling dry. Love this, glad to have been part of the selection for the giveaway.

avis.titre: The Holy Grail-COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream
avis.texte: I have used all of the name brand Ceramide Barrier Creams on the market and this one from COSRX has them all beat. It absorbs quickly and moisturizes all day making your skin feel silky smooth all day an night. You will wake up to unbelievably soft skin after using it in the AM. I am very impressed with this fragrance free, all over body and face moisturizer that it will become a staple in my moisturizing routine. You can't beat the price for the high quality ingredients and the massive amount of product you get with this purchase. Grab yours before it sells out, your skin will thank you.
Feels really nice on the skin. Not at all greasy. Have used it on body and face, face when feeling especially dry.

I was so excited to try the Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream. I use COSRX products daily, they're now a staple in my routine. When I saw this product launch on the website, I knew that I had to get it to level up my body care routine. This cream gives me such a rich and long lasting moisturizer boost that's not greasy or heavy. I've used it on my body but it would definitely help on super dry skin for the face. I will be using this on my body, hands, feet, etc daily. I love the moisturized feeling without having to worry about heaviness or transfer, and not having to smell strong fragrance. A great product!

I've been using it after I wash my hands (I wash a lot of dishes), and my cuticles look pretty good so far. It's unscented and really smooth. It doesn't greasy and absorbs really quickly. My hands are nice and soft without any residue. The consistency is super light and creamy as well.

I tend to break out with rich moisturizers, but I've used it on my face for several days with no issues, and it seems to deliver lasting hydration. I typically prefer a richer moisturizer for a body lotion; this sinks in almost immediately, and my skin doesn't feel different right after application, so I tend to use more than I ordinarily would. That said, the next day, my skin is soft and smooth. It's rare that a product actually works well on both face and body, which makes this extra special.

I've had this cream for about 3 days and so far, so good. I use it after I get out of the shower. A little goes a long way because the cream is thick. It goes on smooth and leaves my skin really soft. Also, the package was secured and no leakage.

COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream is moisturizing without the greasiness! It feels light on the skin. It absorbs into the skin effortlessly and has a very light fragrance that is barely noticeable.

I received this product for free from COSRX, and my first impressions are very positive. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving it feeling soft and hydrated. I've used it twice so far, and I'm impressed with how long the hydration lasts—my skin stays moisturized throughout the day. Plus, a little goes a long way, which is a great bonus considering the generous size of the tub.

Very lightweight, quick absorbing moisturizer. Doesn't leave a heavy or sticky film/layer over the surface of skin. Leans towards the more watery/less viscous consistency. Perfect for the spring/summer/fall. May not be moisturizing enough for the winter though.

avis.titre: The BEST Ceremide Barrier Cream On The Planet
avis.texte: For a true and honest review I waited several days to comment. This is the Holy Grail all over moisturizer. Im 67 and live in the Arizona desert, my skin is very dry and needs constant moisturizing. This ceremide barrier cream beats all others hands down due its high quality ingredients. It absorbs quickly, moisturizes all through the day leaving my skin so soft and bringing back elasticity. I like that you can use it on your face along with your body. The amount of product you get in this tub along with the small amount you need to apply will last for a long time and is absolutely worth it. Trust me, you wont find a better ceremide cream than this one from COSRX.

avis.titre: It sinks in but it doesn't feel tight
avis.texte: I was provided this product for free by COSRX. I have not been using this product long enough to provide an in depth review, but my first impressions of it are great. This sinks in well. I was worried about that because typically creams that sink in well on me aren't hydrating enough so I wake up with sebum all over my T zone and dry, right feeling skin on the rest of my face. I have been using this twice a day with my normal skin care in place of my current moisturizer. When I first apply it my skin feels hydrated and soft. It looks naturally dewy. It doesn't pill under my other products. In the morning the soft, hydrated feeling is gone, but I'm not experiencing the tight, dry, greasy feeling from a product that sinks in so nicely. A little seems to go a long way, which is great for a product in such a large tub.

No fragrance, so it doesn't irritate my skin. Not greasy. Silky smooth. Absorbs perfectly without leaving any filmy residue on my skin. Works great on my face, hands, and body. I couldn't ask for a better moisturizing cream. I absolutely love this product and will certainly order more. Highly recommend!
Feels very lightweight and nourishing. Absorbs quickly and leaves a nice finish. Very soothing on my dry elbows, feet
